name: westron
description: The westron tokens: primitives, the semantic roles that do not depend on a mode, and three modifiers that never set the same token (decisions/0010).

primitive.description: The raw scales that do not depend on a mode. The color ramps differ by theme, so the theme contexts merge them in. Components never use primitives directly.

semantic.description: Roles that do not depend on a mode: colors (aliases of the ramps), motion, opacities, radii, spacing, strokes, text roles.

theme.description: The color theme: the color ramps the palette generator solves for it, and the shadows. A high-contrast theme is its theme plus the colors that differ. Resolved at runtime, by the platform's own switching.

density.description: Spacing and control sizes. compact has no values until the dense components (#33) need them; until then both densities take the control sizes the platform gives. Resolved at runtime, through the environment.

platform.description: Values that differ by platform, in platform/<platform>.tokens.json: the control sizes, which the input decides. No default: each platform's generator names its own. Resolved at build time.
